visual_style.theme_inspiration: Editorial Travel Agency meets Premium Modern Athletic Tech
key_traits: Spacious generous layout with wide margins and breathing room
Soft rounded corners (xl to 2xl radius) with refined 1px subtle borders
Subtle glassmorphism and frosted layers for high depth
Dynamic snap carousels and smooth horizontal swipe strips
Pure Persian typography (Vazirmatn) with numerical and structural clarity
Full Light and Dark mode dual personality

instructions_to_main_agent: Always maintain dir='rtl' on top level containers or document element.
Use Lucide-React or Phosphor Icons for sport icons and UI indicators.
Ensure all interactive elements have explicit data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='hero-search-button', data-testid='theme-toggle-btn').
Use Vazirmatn font throughout the application.
Implement light and dark mode state connected to localStorage and body.classList.
Do NOT make the site monochromatic blue - rely on subtle greyish/slate backgrounds with punchy cyan and vibrant sky blue accents.
Make sure forms have rich micro-interactions and validation states.
All components should be written in JavaScript (.js / .jsx).

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_transparent_overlays: DO NOT use pure transparent background in headers or floating panels. Always use backdrop-blur + semi-opaque white/dark surface.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.component_reuse: Utilize existing UI components from src/components/ui/ (button, card, dialog, select, input, tabs, etc.).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.toasts: Use Sonner for user feedback toasts.
